marketing_description: The SATCO S3703 incandescent light bulb features a 360 degree beam spread and is fully dimmable, making it a versatile option for standard light fixtures with a medium E26 base. This 40 W bulb has a warm white light appearance with a color temperature of 2700 K and a color rendering index of 100. It has an average life of 2000 hours and a clear finish.
